messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — OrionBank sent the SIG back with a few follow-ups. They want per-question evidence for MFA, KMS key ownership, and network segmentation. Can someone take question-by-question assembly? /cc @ajay_se @lina_sec
ajay_se: I can own this. Do we have the latest SIG spreadsheet they used? sometimes vendors attach a slightly modified excel with extra columns.
maria_sales: Attached the PDF they returned and the XLSX they filled (link: https://drive.redwood/workspace/sales/orion/sig-return.pdf and https://drive.redwood/workspace/sales/orion/sig-return.xlsx). They highlighted ~12 questions as high-priority.
lina_sec: Quick clarifying Qs from my side: for KMS, do they require BYOK with HSM attestation, or is customer-managed key in their cloud sufficient? Also need to confirm whether audit logs exported to their SIEM is acceptable vs providing raw CloudTrail objects.
dmitri_orion_risk: For OrionBank: prefer BYOK with HSM attestation for production data; for the POC, customer-managed keys in your cloud are fine but we need key rotation policy evidence and a sample audit log showing key usage. SIEM export is fine if it contains immutable timestamps and key IDs.
ajay_se: Noted. I'll prepare short, question-aligned snippets. For KMS/qn: "We support customer-managed keys (CMK) in Dedicated and Private. BYOK with HSM-backed keys is supported via integrations with AWS KMS/CloudHSM and GCP KMS. Rotation policy: 90 day rotation supported; sample audit entry path: /audit/kms/usage/YYYYMMDD.log. See docs: https://docs.redwood/inference/security/kms"
lina_sec: For MFA questions: we'll provide a screenshot of SSO provider settings + the org-level policy (file names: sso_policy_march2026.png, org_mfa_policy.pdf). For segmentation: include network diagram + firewall rules snippet. I'll assemble those artifacts and a short control mapping (CSV). ETA: end of day tomorrow (1932180000).
maria_sales: Can we meet that ETA? Orion expects the evidence package by Friday EOD. If we miss, they'll push escalation.
ajay_se: I'll draft the per-question responses tonight. Lina, once you drop artifacts I can map them into the SIG xlsx and produce a zip named ORION_SIG_EVIDENCE_193210.zip.
ops_bot: presigned-upload-link created for ORION_SIG_EVIDENCE_193210.zip -> https://uploads.redwood/s/abcd1234 (expires in 7 days) :package:
lina_sec: Uploaded: sso_policy_march2026.png, org_mfa_policy.pdf, network_diagram_v2.png, kms_policy.json, audit_sample_kms.log -> https://uploads.redwood/s/abcd1234/ (files visible). I'll redact account IDs in audit_sample_kms.log and include a README with redaction notes.
dmitri_orion_risk: Thanks — we'll validate once received. Also please include the timestamped key rotation policy records for the last 6 months if possible.
ajay_se: Will include rotation records (anonymized) and a short explanation for each SIG question. I'll post the completed xlsx + the zip to the presigned link when done and ping here.
maria_sales: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Orion risk for Friday morning after they've reviewed the package.
ajay_se: Uploading ORION_SIG_EVIDENCE_193210.zip now.
ops_bot: file uploaded -> ORION_SIG_EVIDENCE_193210.zip (1.2MB) to https://uploads.redwood/s/abcd1234 (sha256: f2c3...9a1).
ajay_se: Done — posted the XLSX with per-question answers and links to artifacts in the "evidence" column. Next: Lina, can you sanity-check the KMS wording?
lina_sec: Reviewing now. I'll post any edits in the xlsx comments.
maria_sales: Perfect. I'll send a short cover email template for the handoff to Orion risk and drop it here for sign-off.
